description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Axis class for handling axes in a graphing library, including methods for axis configuration, rendering, and label management.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis
classes.description: Class for handling axes in a graph, including configuration, rendering, and label management.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis
methods.description: Constructor for the axis, sets default type and style.

methods.name: _pushValues
methods.description: Marks the axis to push values by 0.5, used for specific chart types.

methods.name: _setAxisPadding
methods.description: Sets padding in pixels for axis sides ('low' or 'high').

methods.name: _getTitleFont
methods.description: Retrieves the font used for the axis title, propagating defaults if not set.

methods.name: showLabel
methods.description: Configures which labels (min, zero, max) to display on the axis.

methods.name: setDataPreProcessor
methods.description: Assigns a data preprocessor for label formatting.

methods.name: _getMinimum
methods.description: Returns the minimum value the axis will display.

methods.name: _getMaximum
methods.description: Returns the maximum value the axis will display.

methods.name: _setMinimum
methods.description: Sets the minimum value the axis will display.

methods.name: _setMaximum
methods.description: Sets the maximum value the axis will display.

methods.name: forceMinimum
methods.description: Forces the minimum axis value, optionally marking it as user-set.

methods.name: forceMaximum
methods.description: Forces the maximum axis value, optionally marking it as user-set.

methods.name: showArrow
methods.description: Enables arrow heads at the end of the axis.

methods.name: hideArrow
methods.description: Disables arrow heads at the end of the axis.

methods.name: _labelDistance
methods.description: Calculates distance between labels at a given level.

methods.name: setLabelInterval
methods.description: Sets interval for label display at a specific level.

methods.name: setLabelOption
methods.description: Sets a specific option for labels at a given level.

methods.name: setLabelOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple label options at a specific level.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the axis title and font, with options for vertical orientation.

methods.name: setFixedSize
methods.description: Defines a fixed size (width or height) for the axis.

methods.name: _value
methods.description: Preprocesses a value, e.g., for logarithmic axes.

methods.name: _applyDataset
methods.description: Applies dataset min/max to axis limits.

methods.name: _point
methods.description: Calculates pixel position for a given axis value.

methods.name: _intersectPoint
methods.description: Calculates pixel position for axis intersection points.

methods.name: _calcDelta
methods.description: Calculates pixel-per-unit ratio for the axis.

methods.name: _calcLabelInterval
methods.description: Calculates optimal label interval based on axis span.

methods.name: _getNextLabel
methods.description: Gets the next label position at a given level.

methods.name: _labelInterval
methods.description: Returns the label interval for a level.

methods.name: _size
methods.description: Calculates the pixel size of the axis including labels and title.

methods.name: addMark
methods.description: Adds a mark or range at a specific axis value.

methods.name: _isNumeric
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the axis handles numeric data.

methods.name: setTickOptions
methods.description: Configures major tick mark positions.

methods.name: setInverted
methods.description: Inverts the axis direction.

methods.name: setAxisIntersection
methods.description: Sets where the axis intersects other axes.

methods.name: _getAxisIntersection
methods.description: Retrieves axis intersection configuration.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets internal label text cache.

methods.name: _drawTick
methods.description: Outputs a tick mark and label at a specific value.

methods.name: _drawAxisLines
methods.description: Draws the main axis line and arrowheads.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates coordinates of axis elements.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Renders the axis, including lines, ticks, labels, and marks.
